SchemeSummary.Fund_Type: An open-ended equity investment strategy investing in listed equity and equity related instruments including limited short exposure in equity through derivative instruments.
SchemeSummary.Description_Objective_of_the_scheme: The investment objective of the Investment Strategy is to generate long term capital appreciation over the investment cycle by deploying capital in equity and equity related instruments including limited short exposure through derivatives across the market capitalisation. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Investment Strategy will be achieved.
SchemeSummary.Stated_Asset_Allocation: Equity and equity-related instruments (including unhedged short exposure) - 80% - 100% of net assets,Debt and Money Market Instruments including units of debt oriented mutual fund schemes - 0%-20% of net assets, Units issued by InvITs - 0% - 20% of net assets. Please refer the INVESTMENT STRATEGY Information Document for more details.
SchemeSummary.Fund_Manager_Name: FM 1 - Mr.Rajesh Aynor, FM 2 - Mr.Hiten Bhadra(for Arbitrage portion)
SchemeSummary.Exit_Load_if_applicable: 1% if redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 1 year from the date of allotment of units. Nil if redeemed or switched out after completion of 1 year from the date of allotment of units.
SchemeSummary.RTA_Code_To_be_phased_out: Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Regular Plan - Growth Option-ELSRG, Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Regular Plan - Reinvestment of Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal Option-ELSRR, Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Regular Plan - Payout of Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal Option-ELSRP Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Direct Plan - Growth Option-ELSDG, Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Direct Plan - Reinvestment of IDCW Option-ELSDR, Arthaya Equity Long Short Fund Direct Plan - Payout of Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal (IDCW) Option-ELSDP
SchemeSummary.Listing_Details: As the Investment Strategy is an open ended strategy, and the units of the Investment Strategy will be offered for subscription and redemption at NAV based prices on all Business Days on an on-going basis providing the required liquidity to investors, units of the Investment Strategy are not proposed to be listed on any stock exchange. However, the Trustee reserves the right to list the units of the Investment Strategy on any stock exchange(s) at its sole discretion at a later date.
